text:
Sam: quick async standup — drop 1-2 lines: what you did yesterday / blockers / today

Maya: yesterday - finished ruby SDK quickstart rewrite and updated snippets. pushed draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432
Maya: blocker - macOS wheels failing in CI on M1 runner, error around native_ext build, trying a patch to the build matrix

Jin: yesterday - migrated sample-app to new auth flow, added token refresh logic. tests pass locally.
Jin: blocker - e2e in CI flakes when docker image pulls from private registry (401 intermittently) — filing infra ticket if I can't reproduce by EOD

Alex: yesterday - fixed a couple small typos in the quickstarts and adjusted curl examples to use the new /v1/generate endpoint. PR linked in the thread.
Alex: note - wondering if we should standardize the response examples to include truncated tokens to avoid huge blocks in the docs (happy to make a pass)

Sam: ping @Maya — can you paste the failing wheel logs? I can try the M1 repro on my laptop later.

Maya: logs snippet:
```
Building native_ext
error: command 'clang' failed with exit status 1
ld: library not found for -lssl
```
Maya: trying to add openssl path to build flags, will re-run CI in a fork

CI-bot: build #876 failed for maya/ruby-quickstart (macos-m1) — details: https://ci.internal/876 (retries remaining: 2) :x:

Jin: @Sam re: registry 401 — I suspect credentials rotation. For now I added a fallback to pull from public cache in the sample-app CI. Patch in branch sample-auth-fallback.

Sam: thanks @Jin. If that stabilizes CI we can flip it to be the default until infra fixes the registry token refresh.

Alex: i'll take the docs truncation change after lunch, will open a follow-up PR and tag you all for review.

Maya: quick ask — anyone free for a 15m pairing session at 3pm PT to repro the M1 build? @Sam @Alex?

Sam: I can make 3pm. :thumbsup:

Jin: busy at 3, but I can join for the tail end.

Sam: ok — pairing session created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3pm-m1-debug (invite sent)

Maya: thanks — i’ll bring a minimal repro and the forked CI to demo.

Sam: final: if you're blocked on reviews, drop the PR link here and I'll do quick reviews today — trying to keep the release train moving.

Alex: pinging PRs: #431 #433 — will take a look after lunch.

CI-bot: build #877 queued (sample-app/e2e) — we'll watch for the registry fallback results.

Sam: cool, wrap up here. short checkins only today — shout if anything urgent.
